newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds off lacking impetus, seen lower.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds off lacking impetus, seen lower.

text.p: 1645 GMT - Austrian bonds lacking impetus dipped lower on Tuesday and traders said there remained potential for further losses.
"Nothing's going on in the spot market, the only bit of action is in the futures market," said one trader, noting there were no incentives to give the market direction.
Traders said they hoped U.S. producer prices due out tomorrow would breathe some life into the market.
The German bund future was seen in a narrow 100.51-to-101.00-point range, traders said.
* Latest 10 year benchmark 5.875 pct bond maturing July 2006 up 25 bps at 100.35 to yield 5.82 (5.86) pct in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.18/28 to yield 5.84/83.
* At the near end, five-year 5.50 percent bond maturing March 2001 up 35 bps at 103.30 to yield 4.67 (4.76) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 103.12/22 to yield 4.71/69 percent.
* 10-year spread to German bunds steady at eight bps, five-year spread up one at 21 bps.
* Money market rates steady with three-month VIBOR at 3.350 and overnight money slightly higher at 3.05/30. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
